🎥🍿: Grace and Frankie (2015)

Grace Hanson and Frankie Bergstein couldn’t be more different. Grace is sophisticated and tightly controlled, while Frankie is free-spirited and unconventional. Despite years of knowing each other through their husbands, the two women have never exactly been friends.

Their lives are suddenly turned upside down when their husbands, Robert and Sol, reveal that they are in love with each other and plan to leave their marriages. Forced to navigate an unexpected new chapter, Grace and Frankie reluctantly turn to one another for support as they deal with family drama, dating, aging, and starting over.

What begins as an unlikely partnership gradually becomes a powerful friendship, with Grace and Frankie discovering that life’s biggest surprises can sometimes lead to entirely new beginnings.
